email_subject: Application - Internship Digital Marketing at Decathlon
email_body:
Dear Decathlon Belgium team,

I am writing to apply for the Digital Marketing Internship within your Traffic & Acquisition team. As a digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and web, I am eager to deepen my skills in paid acquisition and contribute to your mission of turning commercial objectives into measurable digital successes.

In my current roles, I manage on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for client websites, using tools like Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics. I have also set up and optimized campaigns on Google Ads, and I am keen to expand this into Meta and TikTok advertising. My technical background allows me to quickly grasp new platforms and use data to optimize performance.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I am available for a 3-6 month internship starting in January or February. I would welcome the opportunity to bring my analytical mindset and creativity to Decathlon.

Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketing Internship at Decathlon Belgium. With a strong foundation in digital marketing and a passion for sports, I am eager to contribute to your Traffic & Acquisition team and learn the art of paid acquisition.

In my current freelance and junior roles, I have gained practical experience in SEO, content creation, and web management. I have worked with Google Ads, Google Analytics, and Search Console, and I am comfortable analyzing campaign performance and proposing optimizations. For example, I have conducted keyword research, written SEO content, and monitored results using tools like Semrush and Ahrefs. I have also built and optimized websites, implementing structured data and technical SEO improvements that drove measurable growth.

While my experience in Meta and TikTok advertising is still developing, I am a quick learner and have already started exploring these platforms. I am confident that my analytical skills and technical background will allow me to quickly master the setup, monitoring, and optimization of campaigns across these channels. I am particularly drawn to Decathlon's dynamic environment and the opportunity to work with creative and commercial teams to align campaigns with business objectives.

I am fluent in English and have a good command of Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+). I am available for a 3-6 month internship starting in January or February. I am excited about the prospect of contributing to Decathlon's digital success and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

- Technical background in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Python, enabling quick mastery of new advertising platforms and data-driven optimization.
- Fluent in English and proficient in Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+), with a passion for sports and teamwork.
- Available for a 3-6 month internship starting January or February, eager to learn and contribute to Decathlon's Traffic & Acquisition team.
